description: The whole 2026 U.S. Senate map in one call: every seat on the ballot with the seat holder and their role (incumbent, appointed, open seat), the structure rating (Toss-up / Lean / Likely / Safe), the named forecasters’ published bands where we track them, and the live Kalshi price — the implied probability the Democrat wins where the legs make that provable, otherwise the favorite contract and its price in cents. Closest race first, with a page URL per seat and the hub. Prices are never estimated: a seat Kalshi has not priced returns null. Free, no key. Use for "2026 Senate map", "which Senate seats are toss-ups", "what does the market say about Senate control race by race", "where do prediction markets disagree with Cook / Sabato".
name: senate_map
title: 2026 Senate Map — every seat, market price vs structure rating vs forecasters
